snippet.title: Kunoichi Botan  - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Botan, an apprentice kunoichi, is summoned by the village chief. Her master had been captured. So she is tasked with the mission to rescue her. However, Botan still lacks experience. Will she really be able to save her master? Find out in this Stealth Action RPG!

Buy it on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2SsjE7S

Kagura Games on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2SibPSb

Developer: Enokippu
Publisher: Kagura Games
